subject: SOC2 renewal: proposed log-retention window change & capacity uptick
messages:
From: Elena Mendez <elena@stratushealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Leib <jordan.leib@stratushealth.com>, Alicia Tran <atr@brightlynx.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC2 renewal: log retention window & capacity needs for upcoming renewal

Hi Rishi,

We're starting our renewal pack for Redwood (term ends 2027-06-30) and our audit firm asked for a few clarifications before they sign off on re-attestation. Two things we're hoping to align on: 1) the log retention window — our compliance team is requesting a 24-month retention for certain audit logs (currently 12 months in our contract); and 2) anticipated capacity — usage has grown and we expect a +35% peak uplift through Q4, so we want to lock in a capacity uplift or a committed headroom plan.

Can you confirm feasibility and any contract/price implications? Jordan is copied for procurement. Alicia from our auditors is CC'd to highlight evidence expectations.

Elena
Director, Security & Compliance
Stratus Health

Attachments: none

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Mendez <elena@stratushealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Leib <jordan.leib@stratushealth.com>, Alicia Tran <atr@brightlynx.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC2 renewal: log retention window & capacity needs for upcoming renewal

Hi Elena — thanks for the heads up and for outlining the ask. Short answers up front: 1) We can support a 24-month retention window for the specified audit logs you list (we'll need to mark which log classes are in scope and whether you want immutable retention or exportable archives). 2) Capacity: we can put a committed buffer in Dedicated for the +35% peak; I put together an initial uplift estimate in the attached spreadsheet and a proposed evidence manifest for the SOC2 recert that our compliance team will produce.

Next steps I propose:
- Jordan: confirm whether Stratus prefers a monthly burst allowance vs. a formal committed capacity uplift (affects pricing/contract language).
- Alicia: can you confirm the list of log types that must be retained 24 months (e.g., auth logs, admin audit, config changes)? If you can drop a short list I'll map them to our retention classes and provide an operational timeline.
- Internal (Cc): Karthik, can you advise on contract amendment language and whether legal wants the 24-month retention as an addendum or a new exhibit?

I'm available for a 30-min sync Wed afternoon.

Thanks,
Rishi
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
Phone: (650) 555-0182

Attachments: redwood-soc2-evidence-manifest-2027-05-10.csv, capacity-uplift-estimate.xlsx

From: Alicia Tran <atr@brightlynx.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Elena Mendez <elena@stratushealth.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 08:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC2 renewal: log retention window & capacity needs for upcoming renewal

Thanks — quick clarification from the audit side: the auditors need immutable retention for security event logs (auth/login, admin actions, schema/config changes) for 24 months. Application-level request logs are acceptable at 12 months. We also need a short narrative describing where logs are stored, export procedures, and a sample log extract (CSV) showing event, timestamp, user id, and action.

If Redwood can provide the sample extract and a retention matrix mapping log classes to retention periods, that will speed our work.

Alicia
Senior Auditor, Brightlynx Compliance

Attachments: none

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 10:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC2 renewal: log retention window & capacity needs for upcoming renewal

Rishi — looped in internal compliance and legal ops. A few notes from my side:
- Contract language: we should add an exhibit ("Audit Log Retention Exhibit") that enumerates log classes and retention periods. That lets us avoid changing core T&Cs but gives Stratus the contractual guarantee they need.
- Costs: 24-month immutable retention will have a storage delta; estimate attached (capacity-uplift-estimate.xlsx). For committed capacity, propose a 12-month term amendment with an optional true-up at renewal.
- Evidence: Grace, can you produce the retention matrix PDF and a sanitized sample CSV for Alicia? Aim to have artifacts uploaded to the shared drive by Friday 14 May.

Happy to review draft exhibit once Rishi has agreement from Stratus.

Karthik
Sr. Counsel, Redwood Inference

Attachments: none

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Mendez <elena@stratushealth.com>, Jordan Leib <jordan.leib@stratushealth.com>, Alicia Tran <atr@brightlynx.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC2 renewal: log retention window & capacity needs for upcoming renewal

Elena / Jordan / Alicia — quick update and proposal: we created the retention matrix and a sanitized sample extract, both uploaded here: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/Stratus/SOC2/renewal-pack (see files log-retention-matrix.pdf and sample-log-extract.csv). Summary:

- Redwood can contractually commit to 24-month immutable retention for the audit log classes Alicia specified. We'll add an "Audit Log Retention Exhibit" to the renewal amendment; Karthik has a first draft and will post it to the drive for review.
- For capacity: we propose a Dedicated uplift of 35% with a 12-month committed term priced in the attached estimate. Optionally, Jordan can choose a monthly burst allowance (no commit) — pricing differs, see the spreadsheet.
- Next steps: Jordan, if procurement signs off on the committed uplift, we can route paperwork through DocuSign this week (I'll prep the amendment + pricing exhibit). Alicia — please confirm the artifacts are sufficient for draft re-attestation.

If helpful, I'll set a 30-min handoff call Thursday to walk through the exhibit and the evidence pack.

Thanks all,
Rishi
Account Exec, Redwood Inference

Attachments: log-retention-matrix.pdf, sample-log-extract.csv, capacity-uplift-estimate.xlsx
